How giving works

Three steps, no surprises.

  • 1

    Choose what your gift funds

    Pick an amount above. Each one is tied to a named, reportable deliverable — books, a library route, an event, or a fellowship seat.

  • 2

    We confirm how to pay

    Your selection reaches our team. We reply with the payment route that suits you, M-Pesa or bank transfer, usually within 3 working days.

  • 3

    You get a receipt and a report

    Every gift is receipted, and where it went appears in our impact reporting. You see the deliverable your money paid for.
